messages.subject: Connectivity test passed; report written
messages.body: Ran the Orca/OpenCode default-agent connectivity test as-is with no model, provider, config or environment change, reading only the first paragraph of AGENTS.md and writing the single owned report. Confirmed the working directory is /home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl, Strata is described there as running the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MoE model on a normal PC with one NVIDIA or AMD GPU plus system RAM, and the model identity is directly exposed in the agent preamble as deepseek-v4.1-flash-free (opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free) rather than inferred. Nothing remains: the report at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/orca-opencode-default-agent-test-v1.txt records these findings and the task is complete with no other files, Git, build, test, GPU or cleanup activity.
